description: Brainwave, Athena, Bulldog and Virtuoso are THE OLYMPIANS - Britain's national superteam...and Britain's national joke. Can Max Tarrant, their new administrator, keep them teammates from killing each other long enough to turn around their disastrous media image? Not likely!

Max Tarrant's wife becomes the newest sidekick hero, Rover, after she finds out about Max's affair with Athena. Meanwhile, the rest of London's heroes fight amongst themselves, leaving the city in shambles.

"I am no one. I come from nowhere--and disappear into nothing." By day, he is a patient in a trauma center. But at night, when he is needed, he rises. For he is Blind Justice, the Man Who Walks Through Bullets! Artist Rick Buckler Jr. makes his ALL TIME COMICS debut, together with writer/artist Josh Bayer and inker Al Milgrom, for a pulse shattering thriller. Justice can't die!
